name: Anna Schafer
bio: Anna Anissimova is an actress and producer, known for The Whistleblower (2010),Father of Invention (2010) and Flutter (2011). She has been married to Peter Schafer since November 20, 2010.

credits.overview: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

credits.title: The Right Mom
credits.overview: While writing an article about an abused boy, a woman fights for protect him after she uncovers shocking details.

credits.title: The Place of No Words
credits.overview: A young boy battles the complexities of a grown-up world with his father.

credits.title: Elizabeth Blue
credits.overview: A young woman, recently released from a mental hospital, is coping with ongoing episodes of schizophrenia.

credits.title: There's Always Woodstock
credits.overview: When Neurotic, struggling songwriter, Catherine Brown's life in New York City falls apart, she is forced to confront her past when she spends the summer at her childhood home in Woodstock.

credits.title: The Trials of Cate McCall
credits.overview: In order to be reinstated to the bar and recover custody of her daughter, a hotshot lawyer, now in recovery and on probation, must take on the appeal of a woman wrongfully convicted of murder.

credits.title: The Whistleblower
credits.overview: Nebraska cop Kathryn Bolkovac discovers a deadly sex trafficking ring while serving as a U.N. peacekeeper in post-war Bosnia. Risking her own life to save the lives of others, she uncovers an international conspiracy that is determined to stop her, no matter the cost.

credits.title: Father of Invention
credits.overview: Nearly a decade after a faulty product landed him in prison, an arrogant inventor is determined to restore his reputation and rebuild his fortune. But first, he has to convince his estranged daughter that he's worthy of a second chance.
